source_title: J&K Chief Minister Omar Abdullah marries journalist Nidhi Razdan - India Today
source_excerpt:
Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah has announced his marriage to journalist Nidhi Razdan, sharing the news on social media on Saturday.
Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah has announced his marriage to journalist Nidhi Razdan, sharing the news on social media on Saturday.
Taking to Instagram, Abdullah posted a picture with Razdan and wrote, “A new journey began yesterday”, tagging her in the post Razdan also confirmed the development through a post on X. Sharing a message while tagging Omar Abdullah , she wrote, “It’s done, bro". advertisement ❮ ❯ Read Full Story The announcement marks a new chapter for the Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister, who shared the update with his followers a day after the wedding. The development comes three months after the Supreme Court agreed to grant Omar Abdullah a divorce from his estranged wife, Payal Abdullah. On July 31, 2026, the Supreme Court said it would dissolve their marriage after both parties informed the court that they had mutually agreed to end their relationship and settle all pending disputes. They also agreed to withdraw the cases filed against each other. The matter reached the Supreme Court after Omar Abdullah challenged the Delhi High Court's decision refusing to grant him a divorce. During the proceedings, the couple jointly submitted an application seeking dissolution of their marriage by mutual consent under Article 142 of the Constitution. Senior advocate Kapil Sibal, appearing for the couple, informed the court that they had agreed to settle their differences. Omar Abdullah and Payal married in 1994 after meeting while working at The Oberoi hotel in Delhi. They have two sons, Zahir and Zamir. The couple had been living separately since 2009, and Omar announced their separation in 2011. The Supreme Court had earlier observed that they had been living apart for several years. - Ends

hi_body:
जम्मू-कश्मीर के मुख्यमंत्री उमर अब्दुल्ला ने शनिवार को सोशल मीडिया पर पोस्ट कर पत्रकार निधि राजदान के साथ अपने विवाह की घोषणा की। रिपोर्ट्स के अनुसार, यह घोषणा शादी के एक दिन बाद की गई।

## सोशल मीडिया पर घोषणा

* **उमर अब्दुल्ला की पोस्ट:** जम्मू-कश्मीर के मुख्यमंत्री ने इंस्टाग्राम पर निधि राजदान के साथ एक तस्वीर साझा करते हुए कैप्शन लिखा, "कल एक नई यात्रा शुरू हुई," और उन्हें टैग किया।
* **निधि राजदान की प्रतिक्रिया:** राजदान ने एक्स (पूर्व में ट्विटर) पर उमर अब्दुल्ला को टैग करते हुए लिखा, "इट्स डन, ब्रो।"

## पिछली शादी और सुप्रीम कोर्ट की कार्यवाही की पृष्ठभूमि
* **आपसी सहमति:** 31 जुलाई 2026 को, सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने कहा था कि दोनों पक्षों द्वारा अपने संबंधों को समाप्त करने, लंबित विवादों को सुलझाने और मामले वापस लेने पर सहमति जताने के बाद वह उनका विवाह भंग कर देगा।
* **कानूनी प्रक्रिया:** यह मामला सुप्रीम कोर्ट तब पहुंचा जब उमर अब्दुल्ला ने दिल्ली उच्च न्यायालय के उस फैसले को चुनौती दी जिसमें तलाक देने से इनकार कर दिया गया था। दंपत्ति ने संविधान के अनुच्छेद 142 के तहत संयुक्त आवेदन प्रस्तुत किया था।
* **पूर्व इतिहास:** उमर अब्दुल्ला और पायल की शादी 1994 में हुई थी और उनके दो बेटे, जाहिर और जमीर हैं। रिपोर्ट्स के अनुसार वे 2009 से अलग रह रहे थे और उमर ने 2011 में उनके अलग होने की घोषणा की थी।

## सत्यापन

इस घोषणा की पुष्टि के लिए उमर अब्दुल्ला और निधि राजदान के आधिकारिक सोशल मीडिया हैंडल देखे जा सकते हैं। सुप्रीम कोर्ट की कार्यवाही से जुड़े आधिकारिक न्यायिक रिकॉर्ड भारत के सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के पोर्टल पर उपलब्ध हैं।

en_body:
Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah announced his marriage to journalist Nidhi Razdan, sharing the update on social media on Saturday. According to reports, the announcement was made a day after the wedding.

## Social Media Announcements

* **Omar Abdullah's Post:** The Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister posted a picture with Nidhi Razdan on Instagram with the caption, "A new journey began yesterday," while tagging her.
* **Nidhi Razdan's Response:** Razdan confirmed the development on X (formerly Twitter) by sharing a message tagging Omar Abdullah, writing, "It’s done, bro."

## Background on Previous Marriage and Supreme Court Proceedings

This development follows legal proceedings regarding Omar Abdullah's previous marriage. Three months prior to the announcement, the Supreme Court of India agreed to grant him a divorce from his estranged wife, Payal Abdullah.

* **Mutual Consent:** On July 31, 2026, the Supreme Court stated it would dissolve the marriage after both parties reported they had mutually agreed to end their relationship, settle pending disputes, and withdraw mutual cases.
* **Legal Path:** The case reached the Supreme Court after Omar Abdullah challenged a Delhi High Court decision that had refused to grant a divorce. The couple submitted a joint application under Article 142 of the Constitution, with senior advocate Kapil Sibal informing the court of the settlement.
* **Prior History:** Omar Abdullah and Payal Abdullah were married in 1994 and share two sons, Zahir and Zamir. Reports indicate they had lived separately since 2009, with Omar Abdullah announcing their separation in 2011.

## Verification and Information Access

Readers seeking to verify this announcement can check the official social media handles of Omar Abdullah and Nidhi Razdan. Official judicial records regarding the Supreme Court proceedings can be consulted through the Supreme Court of India's official portal.
